dedupe_keys.name: engage net zero scenario analysis notebooks

description: ENGAGE net-zero analysis is a set of Jupyter notebooks for comparing integrated-assessment scenarios under stringent climate targets. The IIASA README links the paper, separately hosted ENGAGE Global Scenarios dataset and a rendered notebook version. Users supply the scenario ensemble and select assumptions or pathways; outputs are comparative figures and tables about budgets, energy pathways and target attainability at the source model's regional and time resolution. The published ensemble is global, with model-specific sector detail. GitHub metadata and the README state MIT licensing for notebook code; the scenario explorer has a separate licence. A limitation is that the notebooks reproduce one study and do not themselves generate new energy-system scenarios. They can compare transition assumptions that feed electricity, fuel or industrial infrastructure simulations. The related OSeMOSYS catalogue model is an energy optimisation model, not this scenario-analysis workflow. No scenario data or notebook output was downloaded.
name: ENGAGE net-zero scenario analysis notebooks
